cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Make It Official
cards.instruction: Recruit someone by giving them a title, role, or ceremonial duty that makes participation feel binding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Be honorary patron of our roof appeal. You can open it and thank the donors; I've spent enough evenings coaching you through two-minute speeches.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll come, but I won't speak.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At least you said that firmly. Wear the patron's ribbon and lead the applause instead; you remember how we practised facing the room.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I leave after the first donation?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The patron thanks every donor. Stay facing them, the way we practised, and clap for each one. They shouldn't see their patron leaving after the first cheque.
